name: Phoenix Rising Embrace the Chase
description:
Welcome to Phoenix Rising – Embrace the Chase. You have the choice to either ride with the group socializing as a WIND BREAKER (D GROUP) WHICH IS *****BANDED***** YOU WILL NOT RIDE ALONE or you can be a WATT BOMBER and close the initial 5-minute gap to the group by GIVING IT YOUR ALL AND TESTING YOUR VO2 MAX! This event has a little bit of everything. The only rule is that we encourage everyone to keep going and have some fun. We are dedicated to helping riders achieve their goals through teamwork, friendships and most of all unwavering support.
Join us every week to do something a little different and you will hopefully have some fun riding with us. To chase or be chased. Whichever you choose, embrace it!

name: Bikealicious Wednesday Worlds
description:
Originating with a group a Zwifters located near Boston, Massachusetts, Wednesday Worlds is a banded/stay together ride open to cyclists and triathletes of all abilities, with novice/intermediate/advanced participants especially welcome. As a stay together (Rubberband) ride, you never will get dropped, ( unless you stop pedaling) thanks to Zwift's banded group ride feature. Ride as hard or as easy as you like, without worry of disrupting the overall ride. The goal of this ride is to provide a supportive opportunity for Zwifters to get together to ride and (if desired) socialize. Courses will vary each week and each ride will run 60 or 90 minutes. If you are looking for a consistent weekly ride with all-around enthusiastic people who are interested in all aspects of cycling, this event might be for you!


Your ride leader has a 40+ year history of top level cycling competition on both the road and track. Additionally, he draws on many years of coaching regional and national level cyclists and his work on aerodynamic testing to provide additional support to ride participants. Questions during the ride are encouraged!

name: Major Taylor 1899 (MT1899) Whirlwind Wednesday
description:
Join us for the Major Taylor 1899 Whirlwind Wednesday!

The ride leader will hold ~2.0 w/kg on the flats for the first 50 minutes to keep the group together. In the final 10 minutes, the fence drops, time to PUSH THE PACE and see who can hang on!

This is a non-banded ride, so maintaining the stated pace is key to staying with the beacon. Please respect group ride etiquette.

Why Major Taylor?

Marshall Walter Taylor, known as “Major Taylor”, was a trailblazing cycling legend. In 1899, he became the first U.S. born African American world champion in any sport, wining the 1-mile and 2-mile sprint world titles, along with multiple national championships.

This ride is hosted by the Major Taylor 1899 (MT1899) community cycling clubs across the USA united to honor his legacy. The acronym after each ride leader’s name identifies the hosting club.

Want to ride IRL with a local Major Taylor club?
https://www.majortaylorassociation.org/friends.shtml

Fun FACT: One of Major Taylor’s nicknames was “The Worcester Whirlwind.”

During the months of May through October there may be rides without an assigned ride leader due to the outdoor riding season. We invite all to connect with us on the social media platforms below to stay in the know:

Complete the ride to earn your Major Taylor Whirlwind Kit

name: Mercredi JZQc
description:
Les Mercredis JZQc sont devenus au fil des années un véritable classique de notre communauté. C’est une sortie accessible et rassembleuse où des cyclistes de différents niveaux se retrouvent avec un même objectif : rouler à leur façon, relever leur propre défi et surtout avoir du plaisir ensemble.

À la tête du peloton, vous retrouverez notre fidèle Jeannot, alias le Road Runner, qui accompagne la gang semaine après semaine.

Une sortie où chacun choisit son rythme
Le concept des Mercredis JZQc est simple : vous faites votre mercredi à votre façon!

Vous pouvez suivre Jeannot et le peloton si le rythme vous convient, partir devant si vous avez envie de pousser davantage, ou encore gérer tranquillement votre effort à l’arrière avec des cyclistes qui roulent à une allure semblable à la vôtre.

Il n’est donc pas nécessaire d’être le plus rapide ni de chercher constamment la performance. Certains viennent pour travailler leur endurance, d’autres pour se dépasser, certains pour profiter du peloton et plusieurs simplement pour passer une belle soirée sur le vélo.

🚴 Plusieurs niveaux, un même rendez-vous
Les parcours changent au fil de la saison, avec une préférence pour des parcours plats et roulants qui permettent de profiter davantage du peloton et de rouler avec d’autres membres de la communauté.

Que vous soyez en grande forme ou que vos jambes aient décidé de prendre ça un peu plus relax ce soir-là, vous adaptez votre sortie à votre condition et à vos objectifs du jour.

Vous pouvez :

🚴 suivre le leader et le peloton;

💪 partir devant et vous lancer votre propre défi;

😎 rouler plus tranquillement à votre rythme;

👥 rejoindre des amis ou d’autres membres ayant une allure semblable;

🤝 trouver un partenaire de route et partager l’effort.

C’est justement ce qui fait la particularité des Mercredis JZQc : plusieurs niveaux, plusieurs objectifs et plusieurs façons de rouler, mais une seule communauté réunie chaque semaine autour de la même passion.

Que vous soyez membre de JZQc depuis des années ou que vous participiez pour la première fois, vous êtes les bienvenus.

description:
We are in our build phase for a few weeks. Intensity will be added progressively with a variety of workouts targeting top end power. Our favorite high intensity intervals will also continue to make a regular comeback. Use these workouts as a smart addition to your weekly training plans!

ZWIFT WORKOUTS

Want to join more IRLAG Rides and Runs? Check out our upcoming socials rides through our I Race Like a Girl club feature.

ABOUT ANGELA NAETH & I RACE LIKE A GIRL

Angela Naeth is a professional triathlete, coach, and founder of IRACELIKEAGIRL - a community of girls/women who provide opportunities for females of all ages and abilities to support, encourage and inspire one another in the sport of triathlon, cycling, running and swimming. She's raced for over 10 years from Sprint to Ironman and has coached triathletes/runners/cyclists for the last 7 years. https://www.iracelikeagirl.com/

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 43K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

Keep the pace conversational, chat with the creators, and experience the community vibe first-hand - and if you feel like opening up the legs, the final km is yours to attack. The Best Part? name: USMeS OpsTempo
description:
Welcome to USMeS OpsTempo
Operations Tempo is all about finding your rhythm, keeping the group moving, and enjoying the ride without forgetting to put in some honest work. Think of it as the sweet spot between social cruising and "let's see what these legs have for today."

✅ Average: 2.0–2.5 w/kg
✅ Duration: 60 Minutes

We aim for an overall ~2.25 w/kg average,
We do push on climbs, and segments are encouraged to keep things interesting.
Have a little fun, throw down if you're feeling it, then fall back in quickly and help keep the group rolling together smoothly.

Ride smart. Respect the leader. Respect the pace. Protect the group.
Keep the tempo high. Keep the team together.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

https://www.noble-pro.com/

name: Stage 2 - Zwift Power Play
description:
It’s game on. Power Play is four weeks of gameplay-inspired riding designed to help you beat your best. Each stage puts a different Zwift feature in play, with guided cues, curated PowerUps, and rewards along the way.

STAGE 2 — SHORT TEMPO
Route: Sacré Trois!
Distance: 27.6 km / 17.1 mi
Elevation: 228 m / 748 ft
Three trips up the Montmartre KOM. Your first effort sets the benchmark, while your HoloReplay returns on efforts two and three as the rival to beat. Use your Feather PowerUp wisely to shave off seconds and find an edge.

Set up your HoloReplay for your best personal efforts. Go to Settings and then Preferences—set Segment HoloReplay to Most Recent, Leaderboard HoloReplay to Hide, and HoloReplay Privacy to Private.

name: Bike MS - Banded Wednesday Night Wahoos
description:
Bike MS Wednesday Night Wahoos is a Banded Ride for those looking to explore the many worlds of Zwitt. Just like the many Bike MS Events across the US there is something for everyone. Whether you have a connection to multiple sclerosis or are just along for the experience (points) we are excited to have you along for the journey. Whatever the wekly route is, come join a group of passionate cyclists looking to raise funds and awarenes for those living with multiple sclerosis. All Zwift riders are welcome as we ride for a world free of MS. We hope you enjoy the ride and if so, please join Bike MS Zwift Club for year round training and community engagement. Come for the miles of smiles and stay for the XP. 
Bike MS is the largest charity cycling series across the United States consisting of 50 rides and raising over $50 million in 2024 for the National MS Society. Bike MS supports the National MS Society's mission to Cure MS while empowing all people affected by MS to live their best lives. Whether you want to cross the Finish Line in person or take on a new challenge from anywhere — there’s a Bike MS event that’s right for you! 
Check out www.bikeMS.org and experience the ride of your life. Use code Zwift25 for a discount when signing up for a Bike MS in person event.
Come join us for weekly Club Rides: Bike MS ZC
#dontjustride #bikeMS #whateverittakes #strongertogether

name: Hincapie Sportswear Power Hour
description: Sweet Spot Training. This workout focuses on (2) 15 minute "sweet spot" intervals, which are at 88-93% of your current FTP. These intervals train your body to resist fatigue during prolonged periods at a power output just below threshold. Over time, you want to move to longer intervals and more total time in zone. Rest intervals will be 5 minutes or less. Total Time in zone: 30 minutes.

name: Good Time Riders - Pursuit Race
description:
Also known as Chase races, or Cat and Mouse races, the D category riders will start first, followed by a staggered start for C, B and finally A riders. Keep an eye on the map to see where the other riders are. Who will make it to the finish first? 

You’ll need to work in groups to try and reach the final few kilometres of the race somewhere near the front,  and then it’s all out effort for the overall win. 
 
Good Time Riders (GTR) are a group of Zwifters from across the world who enjoy
riding, training and racing together. We race hard, encourage one another
to be their best, but enjoyment comes first. We have active teams at all
levels racing in Club Ladder, TTT, ZRL and DIRT series. We also run a
regular group rides for the Zwift community on Mondays and Fridays. New members are always very welcome, you can find us on the Companion App, Zwift Clubs, Facebook and Discord.

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: FRR PowerLeague S1 - FINISHER Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you the Power League, where you decide what you are and just go race for your Club.

Three race formats to choose from Sprinter, Climber and Finisher - if you like to power through a race in an iTT then choose the Finisher race, otherwise the other 2 options are self explanatory.

Scoring
Sprint races award points for SPRINT segments ONLY by fastest time by Pen across all race times and finish points from your race - if there is a climb there are no points for them.
Climb races award points for CLIMB segments ONLY by fastest time by Pen across all race times and finish points from your race - if there is a sprints there are no points for them.
iTT races it's all about time to finish by pen across all race times

Best 2 scoring riders from each race and class count for the Clubs Team score

Results are by gender but for this first series we will keep everyone together using ZRS to separate the Pens

Leaderboards by Club, Race format all by each racing class

For all details and registration vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - PowerLeague channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers & Power Meters
- Smart Trainers must be used as a riders PRIMARY POWER SOURCE
- POWER METERS can be used as Primary source if a Smart Trainer is not available for all other divisiions
- Riders must understand that if verification is required that Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform if a rider has used a power meter as a primary power source over a smart trainer. 

Why is this important - Video's may show that a riders BIO is fine and their setup looks good but this doesn't confirm that's what they used - we can now verify the trainer connected where required because it is known that PMs data can be altered and settings tweaked to produce more power.

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

description: WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

name: Bikealicious 🐅 Tiger Wednesdays
description: We are a friendly gathering of cycling enthusiasts. We ride for 90 to 120 minutes but no less than 15 miles. You can ride 30 min, 60 min or up to 120min depending on the route. Bikealicious assigns new routes every Wednesday, to keep the workout fresh and fun for all the zwifters. We ride with a rubber band to motivate all skill sets to stay together through challenging routes, resulting in an interactive and dynamic workout. Our group includes riders of all power levels. We welcome all riders.

name: WTRL Duathlon Opt21 BIKE
description:
WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

The series takes place every Wednesday year-round, allowing you to compete solo or for your club (or both!), with results and monthly leagues organized by age group, gender, and Zwift Club.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
You'll need to complete both the CYCLING and RUNNING events of the same option and complete at least 100m in each to record a score.

NO TREADMILL?
No problem! You can complete the run outside of Zwift. 
- Link your WTRL profile (www.wtrl.racing/profile/) to your Strava profile (Strava is free). 
- Sign-up for the Run Option through the Companion Zpp (but do not 'join the running event in-game). 
- Start and record your run on Strava within 5 minutes of finishing the bike ride, and we’ll handle the rest (your run score is usually processed within an hour).

FORMAT:
- 35 minutes of CYCLING 
- 7 minute 'Transition'
- 20 minutes of RUNNING

For full details, scoring, and registration, visit www.WTRL.racing/duathlon.

#wtrl #duathlon

name: Hump Day Ride p/b Team Giant
description:
The Giant Hump Day Ride is two events in one, starting with a moderate effort of 2.6 – 3.0 w/kg. Use this time to warm-up, chat with fellow Zwifters, and maybe decide on a wheel or two you’re ready to get on.

Because this Giant ride gets spicy after the leader announces the start of the After Party: a 20-minute race. Be sure to listen to the ride leader’s instructions, before digging deep. Or not. If you want to keep it casual, it’s all good.

During the After Party the ride leader acts as a sweep, riding with the After Party cruisers, so everyone finishes together.

Complete the Giant Ride, and you’ll automatically unlock the awesome Giant kit! Join in the fun!

name: Stage 2 - Zwift Power Play
description:
It’s game on. Power Play is four weeks of gameplay-inspired riding designed to help you beat your best. Each stage puts a different Zwift feature in play, with guided cues, curated PowerUps, and rewards along the way.

STAGE 2 — SHORT TEMPO
Route: Sacré Trois!
Distance: 27.6 km / 17.1 mi
Elevation: 228 m / 748 ft
Three trips up the Montmartre KOM. Your first effort sets the benchmark, while your HoloReplay returns on efforts two and three as the rival to beat. Use your Feather PowerUp wisely to shave off seconds and find an edge.

Set up your HoloReplay for your best personal efforts. Go to Settings and then Preferences—set Segment HoloReplay to Most Recent, Leaderboard HoloReplay to Hide, and HoloReplay Privacy to Private.

name: The Driveway Wednesday Worlds
description:
Let's make crits great again! 

Time to face the facts, sprinting is king when it comes to Zwift racing.  This 4-race multi-lap race rotation is designed to be fast and furious.  Use your power ups to plan a team breakaway.  Deploy a burrito for a solo attack.  Sit in the draft as long as you can before igniting your watt-bomb at the finish line. 

Whatever your tactic, practice it here to become a legendary Zwift racer!

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Steep Ramps
description:
Created by Mountain Massif in collaboration with Vekta, this structured training session is part of an 8-week plan designed to get you fit and back to your best. The plan was built using AI and years of real training data held in Vekta, learning from what has worked before to create a progressive programme of three sessions a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. This is week 3, Wednesday.  About the session: Five steep ramps at VO2max. Short enough to stay focused, hard enough to make real gains.
Session details:
Warm Up 
12 min 45%–75% FTP

Openers 
3 x 15 s @ 110% FTP / 45 s @ 55% FTP

5 x Efforts 
3 min 115% FTP, 95 rpm
3 min recovery between efforts @ 50% FTP

Recovery 
3 min 60% FTP, free cadence

Cool Down 
6 min 40%–55% FTP

Total Time: 51 minutes

Key coaching cues:
Breathe deeply and rhythmically from the start of each rep. Ride in ERG mode: every target is a percentage of your FTP, so the session suits all levels.

Safety Note:  Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information: For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

name: Stonegrinder Series
description:
Welcome to the Stonegrinder Series, 8 weeks of racing across selected Brick and Cobble sectors from around Zwift.

Each week features one designated Sprint or KOM segment. Some rounds will be short and explosive, others much longer, but only one thing matters: your fastest time through the selected segment.

Drafting is disabled, power ups are off and TT bikes are not allowed. Bike and wheel choice is otherwise completely open.

Most events use a custom finish shortly after the selected segment. The event finish itself does not count towards the series. It is only there to make sure the full segment is completed and recorded.

There are 4 global time slots each week. You can race more than one slot, with your fastest valid segment time of the round counting towards the league.

The standings are based first on how many rounds you complete, then on your cumulative segment time. So 8 completed rounds will always rank ahead of 7, 7 ahead of 6, and so on.

Season 1 runs every Wednesday from 4th November to 23rd December.

Live standings and league positions will be available on ZwiftPower.

name: WTRL Duathlon Opt21 RUN
description:
WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

The series takes place every Wednesday year-round, allowing you to compete solo or for your club (or both!), with results and monthly leagues organized by age group, gender, and Zwift Club.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
You'll need to complete both the CYCLING and RUNNING events of the same option and complete at least 100m in each to record a score.

NO TREADMILL?
No problem! You can complete the run outside of Zwift. 
- Link your WTRL profile (www.wtrl.racing/profile/) to your Strava profile (Strava is free). 
- Sign-up for the Run Option through the Companion Zpp (but do not 'join the running event in-game). 
- Start and record your run on Strava within 5 minutes of finishing the bike ride, and we’ll handle the rest (your run score is usually processed within an hour).

FORMAT:
- 35 minutes of CYCLING 
- 7 minute 'Transition'
- 20 minutes of RUNNING

For full details, scoring, and registration, visit www.WTRL.racing/duathlon.

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Mountain 8 | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: Cycle Nation Nightcrawler Ride
description:
Welcome to The Dirty One—the Nightcrawler ride where we trade smooth tarmac for gravel most of the time and embrace a little controlled chaos. We still roll at our signature sub-1.8 w/kg pace, so everyone stays together. But on Thursdays, the route is all about adventure. Expect dusty trails, rolling gravel roads, plenty of laughs, and a crew that’s never afraid to leave the pavement behind. Whether you’re chasing endurance, looking for a social ride, or just want something a little different, The Dirty One delivers. No racing, no pressure, no one gets left behind—just a bunch of Nightcrawlers enjoying the ride.

Gravel routes on Zwift are limited, so every now and then we’ll stick to the roads. But one thing never changes: the relaxed pace, the great company, and the fun that keeps everyone coming back. So grab your bike, bring your sense of adventure, and don’t be afraid to get your virtual tyres dirty. The Nightcrawlers ride together. Thursdays, we ride dirty.

name: Workout Wednesday Run
description:
Join the Zwift Runners for a group run workout that will be of benefit to all distance runners.

The speeds for each group are based on a threshold speed of A group 15 kph, B 13 kph, C 11 kph, D 9 kph. We will start the intervals at that speed but increase the speed of the intervals we get into the workout. We encourage runners to choose the group closest to the effort level you want to run at and to keep to the nominal speed for that group to maintain the group dynamic. However if these speeds are significantly too low or high for you then you can choose to run in the group that is closest and then adjust the target speed up to 10% up or down in the game or via the Companion app.

If you have any questions about this event or want to find out more about Zwift Running in general then please visit the Zwift Runners Facebook group or zwift.com/run #gozwiftrun #wow

name: Power Loop
description:
Power Loop”, designed to enhance muscular endurance, cadence control, and
mental resilience. The session is FTP-based and includes motivational cues,
recovery phases, and a final push, making it ideal for riders looking to build
strength and rhythm indoors. 



A circuit of strength and control designed to push your limits and build resilience.




Perfect for developing muscular endurance, rhythm control, and mental toughness. Every loop prepares you for tougher challenges ahead—inside or on the road.



Interval Breakdown:



1. Warm-Up – 10 minutes



3 min in Z1 @ 90 RPM
3 min in Z2 @ 95 RPM

2 min in Z3 @ 95 RPM — steady sub-threshold push
1 min in Z4 @ 85 RPM — near threshold, slower cadence
1 min in Z5 @ 75 RPM — VO2 max effort, low cadence strength

1 min in Z4 @ 100 RPM — FTP effort with fast legs
2 min in Z2 @ 85 RPM — recovery at sweet spot


3. Active Recovery – 5 minutes

5 min in Z1 @ 90 RPM


4. Final Push – 4 minutes

2 min in Z4 @ 90 RPM
2 min in Z5 @ 100 RPM


5. Cool Down – 5 minutes

5 min in Z1 @ 85 RPM

name: WTRL Duathlon Opt23 RUN
description:
WTRL's Duathlon League offers a unique and thrilling racing experience by combining biking on Zwift with the choice of running on Zwift or outside in real life. This makes it accessible to everyone and the ultimate test of racing versatility!

The series takes place every Wednesday year-round, allowing you to compete solo or for your club (or both!), with results and monthly leagues organized by age group, gender, and Zwift Club.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
You'll need to complete both the CYCLING and RUNNING events of the same option and complete at least 100m in each to record a score.

NO TREADMILL?
No problem! You can complete the run outside of Zwift. 
- Link your WTRL profile (www.wtrl.racing/profile/) to your Strava profile (Strava is free). 
- Sign-up for the Run Option through the Companion Zpp (but do not 'join the running event in-game). 
- Start and record your run on Strava within 5 minutes of finishing the bike ride, and we’ll handle the rest (your run score is usually processed within an hour).

FORMAT:
- 35 minutes of CYCLING 
- 7 minute 'Transition'
- 20 minutes of RUNNING

For full details, scoring, and registration, visit www.WTRL.racing/duathlon.

#wtrl #duathlon

name: The Zombie 5k
description:

name: Endure IQ Training Squad Session
description:
SESSION FOCUS:
The focus of this session is on building your tolerance to workloads at and
above the anaerobic threshold and increasing your capacity to buffer acid
production. This session should be guided by power/pace and takes place in the
L4 training zone. These sessions are stressful but great for generating
adaptations relevant to acid-base balance and your ability to re-uptake and
utilize lactate.

WARM-UP:
20 min progressive warmup
PREP SET:
5 x 15 seconds L4 45 seconds L1
2 min recovery
MAIN SET:
2 x 1 min @ L4 with 30 sec recovery
2 x 2 min @ L4 with 60 sec recovery
2 x 3 min @ L4 with 75 sec recovery
2 x 4 min @ L4 with 1 min 45 sec recovery
COOLDOWN:
10 min L1

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone1
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #397

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category

description:
Welcome to the Evolution Cycling Club [EVO] interval session. These rides are geared towards Zwifters that are looking for a varied content one hour session that can give them a full 5 zone workout. Draft in the group and stay zone 1-3, or move to the front and join the sprints for zones 4 and 5 for short bursts. Average for this ride will be mid to high Category B but it may vary based upon course/leader. There will be keepers at the back, and they will try hard to save dropped riders. The group is based upon high social interaction so bring your best banter. Use the mobile app or a keyboard to communicate in-ride.

name: Kiwi Crew Ride
description:
Established in 2018 by former NZ Tour Pro Greg Henderson this Kiwi group ride is now a classic! Our community continues to grow with some of NZ's best E-Sports racers taking to the line each week.

The ride starts off at a moderate 2.5 w/kg average where there’s time for a bit of banter or to spin a good yarn so stay close as you don't want to miss out on the fun! But rachet up the shoes because at the 30 minute mark things get spicy with the Riot After Party! Race to the finish and see how long you can hang on or if you can take on some of the best!

Will you be this weeks Riot winner?

Please respect the ride and stay with the ride leader (yellow beacon) until the Riot hits with around 15 mins remaining, at that point you can race the riot to the finish, or cruise to the finish. Everyone is welcome to join.

* Everyone with a Power Meter and / or Smart Trainer is welcome to join.
* Use of the Coffee Stop during the Riot will incur a 1 min time penalty.
* New cadence rules in play.
* Winners subject to verification requests.

name: INC Relentless Intervals
description:
Suitable for A riders as a base session, or B & C riders wanting to push themselves.

Examples of the drills are – Z2 with 15sec Z5/6 bursts every 6minutes, alternating Z2/Z3 in various durations, Z2 - Z4 ramps of decreasing duration and many other sessions.

All sessions will be around 60-90mins and will include a warm up so just grab your bottles and head straight to the pen.

This is an Innovation Cycling Training Ride Event – all riders are welcome. These events are put together to push you further than before, if you are feeling fresh hop on the front, if you need rest surf the draft. This training ride is part of the INC RELENTLESS training rides that happen daily with each day focusing on a different area of improvement.

Tips: Use the draft to rest and ensure you do not lose the draft.

name: Bens Bash
description:
Training ride open to all. The aim of these rides is to provide a regular training ride for all to join in, riding at a steady pace that for some will feel challenging but over time you will get fitter and more comfortable.

Be mindful of your pace and try to keep the group together rather than just ride off on your own - look at this as a way to improve your fitness as well as pick up some skills around riding with others. 

Try not to ride over 3.5 w/kg but if you are feeling frisky - feel free to open the taps with 10 mins to go. 

We will vary the routes so check back regularly.

name: SZR Early Birdies
description:
Welcome to SZR Early Birdies

This is a group ride with the focus on remaining together. The average pace PRIOR to any race finish will be 2.2 wkg. Sprints and intervals will be added at the discretion of the leader and we will at time ride above and below the advertised pace!

Please regroup quickly after sprints, intervals or hills and sit between the yellow and red beacons.
This ride will particularly benefit D and lower C riders looking to get stronger.

#SZR

name: 3R Octane Interval Ride [~3.2-3.6 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride Event. 3R Octane runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 3.2-3.8 W/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides, including weekly recovery, or transitional, rides which are usually on a Monday. Short, high intensity intervals, longer sweetspot intervals, flying laps, long and short climbs and exploring little used routes all feature.

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some can be up to two hours long, and all end with a mini race.

The Group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the Octane discord server and features a super bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

#Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise #3r

The Group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the Octane discord server and features a super bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

name: 3R SPARK Interval Ride [~2.2-2.5 w/kg avg]
description: This is a 3R Group Ride Event (not a race). 3R Spark runs five days a week and is designed to be an accessible and sociable training session, aimed primarily at riders is Cat-D. Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.0-2.5 W/kg. The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides. Mondays and Tuesdays are our entry-level steady-state rides, where we aim to hold a steady 2.0-2.2 throughout. Wednesdays are a steady recovery ride, where we split into two different ability groups. Thursdays and Fridays are our interval sessions, designed to help Cat D riders push themselves a little further. For interval sessions we aim to average between 2.2-2.5 for the session, but there will be times above and below. Thursday and Friday sessions often include an optional mini-race at the end. Rides are typically around an hour long. Spark is a great introduction to group rides on Zwift, we are a friendly and supportive group who love to see one another succeed. We always have a sweeper (red beacon) whose wheel you can grab if you get dropped. There’s always plenty of good chat, via in-ride messages or on Discord. Come and join us! Join the 3R Facebook group for more info: https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #3R #RideRaceRaise

name: 3R VOLT Interval Ride [~2.6-3.2 w/kg avg]
description:
This is a 3R Group Ride so please follow the leader beacon's (Yellow) instructions and if you are feeling strong, please help the keeper beacon (Red) to assist other riders back to the pack. 3R VOLT runs five days a week and is designed to provide a solid and fun training platform for riders.

Different ride leaders target different effort levels and courses, with power averages in the range 2.8-3.2 w/kg.

The wide spread reflects the diversity of rides and training needs, the following is a typical week:
Monday – After what has hopefully been a fun backed weekend on the bike, this our recovery session
Tuesday – Tends to be more of a classic interval session, riders usually finish with an average of around 3.0w/kg
Wednesday – We take to the hills and one of our tougher sessions with riders averaging around 3.2w/kg
Thursday – is our no red beacon ride and again tough interval sets and riders finishing around 3.2w/kg
Friday - is a little different, we don't take ourselves too seriously and often play a variety of games and quizzes along side the intervals and riders end up with around 2.8-3.0w/kg

The rides are typically around an hour long, but some may take up to 75mins with the majority finishing with either a ramp or a mini race.

The group welcomes rider interaction through messaging and the VOLT discord server and features a friendly bunch of regulars to which newcomers, and riders stepping up from lower intensity rides, are always welcome. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/

This group ride is not a race so. We welcome any feedback on our Facebook page https://www.facebook.com/groups/ClubWorldBicycleRelief/ #Team3R #Ride3R #RideRaceRaise.

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone3
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #397

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: NPRC - Run Every Day Powered By NoblePro
description:
Come and join the fastest growing running club on Zwift.  With a choice of 5 or 10k you can pick your distance. Whether you are a beginner or experienced runner come and join us, you can run at whatever pace you like, it’s not a race unless you want it to be!

Each day is a different route and as new routes are released the courses will change to allow you to bag that badge.

You will run in our in game NPRC jersey and if you complete the event you get to keep it to wear wherever you like.

We also hold special events where you can win an actual jersey to wear in real life.

https://www.noble-pro.com/

You can run structured treadmill workouts, connect and integrate with your favourite bluetooth fitness apps such as Zwift, Rouvy, Kinomaps and many more. We are focused on progress and advancement in integration, connectivity and control.
https://kinni.co/https://kinni.co/devices/ - To see if your treadmill is compatible to link to Zwift.

name: MAAP In The Field: UK Group Ride
description:
MAAP In The Field: UK Group Ride

Join the MAAP crew each week, we’ll roll as a group at a moderate 2-2.5 w/kg pace. The course varies each week, with a range of undulating routes. Join our global community for a social ride and unlock the exclusive MAAP kit. Jump on the chat, ask us any questions you might have and remember that this isn’t a race, save that for Wednesdays!


How do I unlock the Off The MAAP Kit?


Not only will you be repping the kit in-event, but finish any of our weekly rides to unlock the Off The MAAP Kit in your garage, so you can proudly wear the M-Flag design on any ride.

About MAAP:

MAAP exists for the progression of cycling. An independent brand, we’re committed to bringing a new perspective on performance cycling apparel. Every piece that we design evokes our obsession with quality, function, and precision. Fabrics are hand-selected from premier Swiss and Italian mills and are constructed at the most respected factories across Europe. Using the feedback and support from racing teams and cyclists around the globe, our industry-leading product developers are relentlessly refining and evolving every product, season after season. Visit: maap.cc

Stay up to date with the latest MAAP In The Field rides, product launches, cycling events and see who’s topping the leaderboards each week. Connect with the global MAAP community by joining our MAAP Strava Club: https://www.strava.com/clubs/293623 for a global epic from our In the Field series, stay posted on our Facebook page: http://facebook.com/maap.cc or fill your feed via: https://www.instagram.com/maap.cc/.

name: Stage 2 - Zwift Power Play
description:
It’s game on. Power Play is four weeks of gameplay-inspired riding designed to help you beat your best. Each stage puts a different Zwift feature in play, with guided cues, curated PowerUps, and rewards along the way.

STAGE 2 — SHORT TEMPO
Route: Sacré Trois!
Distance: 27.6 km / 17.1 mi
Elevation: 228 m / 748 ft
Three trips up the Montmartre KOM. Your first effort sets the benchmark, while your HoloReplay returns on efforts two and three as the rival to beat. Use your Feather PowerUp wisely to shave off seconds and find an edge.

Set up your HoloReplay for your best personal efforts. Go to Settings and then Preferences—set Segment HoloReplay to Most Recent, Leaderboard HoloReplay to Hide, and HoloReplay Privacy to Private.

name: GXY SURGE
description:
EVENT DESCRIPTION

Part of the SURGE group of events, Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday at the same time.  

This event brings a different workout structure each of the four days of the week.  This may include power pyramids, intervals and chase strategies.  Expect a fun social event where sprints and Kom segments may be included.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category    - D

Power 	    - 1.6 > 2.5wkg but expect the event to finish around 2.1wkg based on a 75kg rider.

Fence 	    - Will be set to KICK! used at the leader's discretion

Draft	    - Enabled – focus required to stay within the group

Sweeper     - Yes! Red beacon and beacon support riders will have a GXY tag after their name

ETHOS 

We at GXY are committed to creating a culture of belonging, inclusivity and compassion empowering people to grow stronger, work together and support one another to achieve shared success on Zwift

name: ZLDR Easy 30
description:
Join Zwift Long-Distance Runners (ZLDR) run club for a relaxed 30 minute run. Whether you want to use this time to walk just to get your blood flowing or push for a new personal best or anything in between, this is a great session to join! Even if you can’t join for 30 minutes, come for whatever you have available. We are a flexible group of walkers/runners who want to help you get consistent and get results.

ZLDR is a group of diverse people, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners and walkers who want to help you set and achieve new goals!

name: Bikealicious Joy Ride
description:
This is a social ride welcoming all riders. Our mission is to push you further than before, build your endurance, and have fun. If you are feeling strong, push to the front and drag the group; if not, just sit in the peloton.

We have the “rubber-band” activated, which means it’s a no-drop ride. No matter what level you are, you’ll be able to keep up, and the group will stay together. Please note that the overall speed may be lower than in other rides due to the banding effect.

So hop on that bike, grab those bottles, and let’s ride!

eventSubgroups.name: Bikealicious Joy Ride (E)
eventSubgroups.description:
Join us for a fun, social, banded group ride following the same route as the Liv du Tour racers. Whether you’re looking to enjoy the atmosphere, ride with friends, or simply celebrate cycling, this ride is for you—no racing, no pressure, just great company and shared miles.

This tour is a celebration of the Tour de France Femmes and the incredible women who inspire our sport. Everyone is welcome.

name: SZR Sunrise Ride
description:
Welcome to SZR Sunrise

C and D  Ride
Tempo ride with optional sprint sections. Non sprinters will work as a group to create as much draft as we can for the sprinters.
Sprints will be added at the discretion of the leader.
We will at times ride above and below the advertised pace, please don’t feel the need to tell the leader they will be aware but the ride average will be as advertised.
This is NOT a recovery ride, we work hard and work as a team.

E Ride
The focus is on the Group and keeping together while having fun to make the time fly fast!
The ride tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.
Note that the average is for the ride prior to any optional faster finish (with a beacon).
The ride leader will aim (prior to any faster finish) to ride mid parameters after a short warmup period.
There might be slight variations above or below the average during the ride.


NB:
Please always respect the ride leader and follow his / her instructions.
The ride tempo is shown next to the ride category, this is rider weight / gender dependant.

name: Torturefest | ITT Climbing League | Mountain 8 | Week 3
description:
ITT Climbing League where elevation is the target not distance. The clock runs from
Pen to virtual banner finish. The routes have been designed to provide lots of world and
climb variations to keep it interesting and challenging.
Week 1 Max Elevation 250 meters
Week 2 Max Elevation 450 meters
Week 3 Max Elevation 650 meters
Week 4 Max Elevation 850 meters
Week 5 when it rarely happens….Alpe Du Zwift
These races are not like the other KOM segment smash races, racing strategy comes to
play. You will have to work different power ranges, manage energy levels and ponder
bike choices.
• No draft regardless of bike.
• No power up’s just you and your watts.
• Weekly distances will fluctuate, for example week 2 could be 15km and week 3 only
10km, elevation is primary focus.
• Category enforced, must wear HRM.
• Zwift Power league in place for weekly and monthly results. Identical setup to Zwift ITT
Racing. Links below, each month the leagues will be reset. An excel backup is available
on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.
• Some weeks will have long lead-ins to the climb which creates the bike choice
dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: PAOLO BARBERA & SCANNELLATORI SERIALI WORKOUT
description:
"Scannellatori Seriali" is a large community of cyclists, triathletes, and runners. We invite you to join our community by following our Instagram page at https://www.instagram.com/scannellatori_seriali/ or contacting us on Facebook.
 
Coach Paolo Barbera (Please visit www.heycoach.it )   is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healty nutrition and tailored training programs

Paolo is an experienced thriathlete and cyclist, in 2017 opened an endurance training center in milan, Tri60, specilized in indoor training.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed training programs for triathletes, runners and cyclists. Indoor training plays a key role to control pace, cadence and mental strenght.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Paolo’s coachees by following his workouts, at the right intensity, have achieved challenging results.

name: The Herd Thunder Down Under
description:
Join us for a relaxed social ride with The Herd Thunder Down Under and Aussie Herdlings. Let's improve our mindsets and release some stress from your day. We’re stronger together.

You’re welcome to sprint, just start behind the leader and regroup after. All riders are welcome to join. We have sweepers to help, if you fall off the pace. Stronger riders are encouraged to help sweep. This is NOT A RACE!
We are a supportive community and our goal is to encourage new riders to join.

Please join us on Discord during the ride, and our community at http://theherd.club/

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone7
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #397

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: Stage 2 - Zwift Power Play
description:
It’s game on. Power Play is four weeks of gameplay-inspired riding designed to help you beat your best. Each stage puts a different Zwift feature in play, with guided cues, curated PowerUps, and rewards along the way.

STAGE 2 — SHORT TEMPO
Route: Sacré Trois!
Distance: 27.6 km / 17.1 mi
Elevation: 228 m / 748 ft
Three trips up the Montmartre KOM. Your first effort sets the benchmark, while your HoloReplay returns on efforts two and three as the rival to beat. Use your Feather PowerUp wisely to shave off seconds and find an edge.

Set up your HoloReplay for your best personal efforts. Go to Settings and then Preferences—set Segment HoloReplay to Most Recent, Leaderboard HoloReplay to Hide, and HoloReplay Privacy to Private.

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: The Chop by AHDR
description:
AHDR THE CHOP

Being "in the chop" is an Aussie expression that you won't read about in the UCI rulebook. It's one of the many nuances of bike racing that only comes with experience.

Sometimes when you're in a race and find yourself in the final break-away bunch you might get asked "are we in the chop?" or "are we chopping it?". This is referring to collusion between the lead riders to work together until the finish. Many times a break-away will be doomed in the final kilometres because everyone starts playing cat and mouse, attacking, sitting up, etc.

But all that goes out the window in the last lap. This is generally where the group comes together and the final push begins. Working together goes out the window and is every man or woman for themselves for the final sprint to the line.

AHDR The Chop is a flat fast time-based handicap race. Do you always get blown out the back on the start of a multi grade race trying to hang onto the guy going with A grade pushing 5w/kg. Well not on The Chop. Released in Grades there are time splits from D to A with the intention of all coming together at the end for the big finish. Each Grade wears a different AHDR/Zwift kit making each grade easily identifiable on who's wheel you want to catch if they go past.

Races happen on Thursday evenings. We plan to add further races in the future. No single race has been the same. Many variables are at play on The Chop including course (which is generally a flat course), race numbers, and the inevitable sandbaggers. It has been called a team time trail and cat and mouse but the real racers know it only as "THE CHOP". Do you have what it takes to take the glory?

A Grade – AHDR GIANT Kit
B Grade – HDR Kit
C Grade – Fluoro Pink
D Grade – Fluoro Camo

#ahdr #cyclingaustralia

name: Team Italy Spicy Coffee Italian Ride
description:
Se cerchi la giusta compagnia per prepararti al fine settimana sei nel posto giusto.
Lo scopo della SPICY COFFEE ITALIAN RIDE è quello di stare tutti insieme, sfruttare la scia del gruppo e fare due chiacchiere ad un ritmo medio fra i 2.0 e i 2.5 w/kg per 90 minuti, il late join è attivo per 30 minuti.
Questa NON è una gara.
Segui le istruzioni dei leader(giallo) per un gruppo compatto.
Ricordati di non superare la fence (barra rossa) altrimenti verrai eliminato.
Partecipa a questa ride per sbloccare la divisa del team italy.
BUONA PEDALATA A TUTTI
TEAM ITALY organizza una vasta gamma di eventi, tutti con le seguenti regole:
-in una pedalata di categoria D, alcuni ciclisti sono principianti, segui le istruzioni del
leader (logo giallo) che appaiono come testo al centro e tieni presente che il ritmo sarà fra i 2.0 e i 2.5 w/kg
-Il valore w/kg sarà diverso per tutti voi, il motivo principale sarà il peso, seguito dalla
capacità di utilizzare la scia e l'equipaggiamento della vostra bici in gioco
-abilitare i messaggi nelle opzioni zwift, fondamentali per una buona esperienza
-le pedalate della categoria D sono facili per un ciclista con C alto, 3w/kg ftp, impegnative per un C basso, 2.5 w/kg ftp, estreme per un ciclista D con 2 w/kg FTP, lo stesso per le
corse C, facili per un A, 4w/kg ftp, impegnative per B 3.2 w/kg ftp, ed estreme per C con 2.5
w/kg ftp.


Are you looking for the perfect companion and you are training for the weekend? This is the right place.
Spicy Coffee Italian Ride's goal is to stay together, enjoy the group draft, and have a bit of easy chat at an average pace between 2.0 and 2.5 w/kg for 90 minutes, late join is enabled for 30 minutes.
This is NOT A RACE.


Follow the leaders' instructions (yellow beacons) to keep the group tight.
Remember the Fence is KILLER, 60 seconds over and you'll be out of the event.
Join this ride to unlock the Team Italy Jersey.
TEAM ITALY organizes a wide range of events, which all agree to the following rules:
- in a D category ride, some riders are beginners, and follow the leader's instructions (yellow
beacon) that appear as text in the middle and keep in mind that the pace will be between 2.0 and 2.5 w/kg


-The w/kg value will be different for all of you, the main reason will be weight, followed by the
capacity to use the draft and your in-game bike equipment
- enable the messages in Zwift options, fundamental for a great experience
- D category's rides are easy for a high C rider, 3wkg ftp, challenging for a low C, 2.5 w/kg
FTP, is extreme for a D rider with 2 w/kg FTP, same for C rides, easy for an A, 4 w/kg ftp,
challenging for B's, 3.2 w/kg ftp, and extreme for C's 2.5 w/kg ftp.
- if you have any suggestions please let us know

description:

name: 6Points Challenges Group Thursday Training Ride
description:
Please look out for our 6Points Challenges group training rides every week, searching #6Points for our rides on the Zwift website or on Zwift Companion.

You should ride as a group, following the instructions of the yellow beacon ride leader and Red beacon sweeper for any sprints, intervals and spicy segments, regrouping after each when requested. Our lap or distance-limited group rides also have a closing minirace, to start from behind the yellow beacon. The fence may be used to control starts for miniraces. Our 1-hour rides don’t close with a minirace.

Our in-real-life (IRL) Reverence 6Points Mallorca real-life cycling events, with Title sponsor Reverence Hotels, are ridden around Mallorca and raise money for charities in Mallorca. 6Points has already raised over €300,000 for its chosen charities.

6Points Mallorca is a 3-day ride around the whole of the beautiful island of Mallorca, covering a little over 400 kms, climbing 7500 metres and touching the four compass extremities, as well as the highest and lowest points of Mallorca - hence the name 6Points. See https://6pointschallenges.com/ for more about our in-real-life events. We also run events in Ibiza / Formentera and Menorca.

Just as for our Zwift group rides, 6Points Challenges are NOT races. They are opportunities to participate in a challenging ride, in one of several pace groups, with like-minded cyclists, to enjoy Mallorca’s diverse beauty and the friendship and camaraderie of fellow riders. 6Points supports sustainable cycling, whose riders care for the environment and practise courtesy to fellow road users.

The 6Points Zwift group ride

As we expect our IRL riders to be able to ride up to 50 miles at or around a 15mph average, such steady riding members should be comfortable with Zwift Categories C and D. Beacon leaders communicate via Zwift on-screen messaging (always) and/or Discord (sometimes) via your headset to vary the pace to allow for sprints, intervals and optionally a mini-race towards the end of the rides, with regrouping after each sprint. Make as much use of drafting as you can, for more effective sprinting and rest intervals.

During the ride, the beacon will announce any sprints, and the ride will finish with a minirace to the end of the ride, between 3kms and 8kms depending on the course.

Results (the finishing order, relevant to the minirace which we will all start together) can be seen at the end of the ride on screen, and we publish your results on zwiftpower.com too.

All bikes and Power-Ups (PU) are allowed, but it is better not to use TT bikes to ensure drafting. Please add 6Points (X) to your Zwift name to allow your ride presence to be recognised, where X is your own ride category. Categories in Zwift are related to your Functional Threshold Power (FTP); use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg to get the w/kg that applies to you.

On this ride series, all riders are welcome, but bear in mind that rides are designed for either:

Category D: 2 W/kg to 2.5 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 2.5w/kg pace average or below.
Category C: 2.6 W/kg to 3.2 W/kg FTP. The beacon leader will ride to 3.2w/kg pace average or below.

PLEASE NOTE: Strava data for our rides must be open (not private or hidden). Please use a heart rate monitor so that we can monitor correlated power and heart rate to help assure fair riding.

You can use our 6Points Discord channel to talk to each other at https://discord.gg/bPsQCNh.

Please see the 6Points Zwift page at https://6pointschallenges.com for more, including how we support our chosen charities.

https://6pointschallenges.com/

#6Points

PS You can check for any of our rides (group rides, TTs and races) that have been scheduled at any time (up to a week ahead) by searching at https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/6points or on Companion.

For those we run for Glasgow Green Cycle Club, GGCC search on https://www.zwift.com/events/tag/ggcc or on Companion.

For more about specific Zwift courses for our events, see the Zwift Companion schedule, and also https://zwiftinsider.com/ where there is a wealth of information about all things Zwift.

Ride On!!

Please join us weekly on Thursdays at a pace of 2.6-2.8w/kg for 90 minutes.

The 505 rides take place Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday for 90 minutes at the same time and same consistent pace. Saturday's we ride for 120 minutes.

We kick off our rides with a 5 minute pace at 2.2w/kg to get us warmed up and together as a team. The fence is used throughout the ride to keep everyone together. name: Know No Bounds Ride
description:
Welcome to the #KnowNoBounds Ride! A ride where we explore the boundaries (or lack thereof) on Zwift.
The ride will begin with 30 minutes at 3 w/kg, utilizing the fence to keep riders together. At the end of the 30 minutes, riders are free to do as they please:
they can stay together and explore the chosen course for the day, or they can head off to the nearest mountain with friends and race it!

When the 30 minute "fenced" portion of the ride is over, we will #KnowNoBounds. Have bike, will travel.
If needed, you will be able to turn to ride in opposite direction on the circuit to reconnect with the group quicker (if you need restroom or are dropped),
and most importantly, the group is not limited to the in-game courses. We can choose to go up a mountain, along a riverside, or any road we want to!

We’re on a mission: to set everyday cyclists free to explore without limits. And we’re going by bike.

Community and camaraderie in cycling is everything: group chat on this ride is highly encouraged!

name: CRYO-GEN: The Tempo Split
description:
Push your limits, find your rhythm.
Welcome to The Tempo Split, a dynamic tempo session designed to help you build aerobic power and endurance. This isn’t just a group ride; it’s a choose-your-own-adventure workout where you decide how deep to dig.

How it Works
We all start together in a single pen for a 10-20 minute progressive warm-up at a controlled, social pace. Once the warm-up is complete, the “Split” begins.
The Yellow Beacon (Lead): Will begin intervals at a high-tempo pace of 3.2 – 3.5 w/kg. This is for those looking to challenge their sustained power.
The Red Beacon (Sweep): Will begin intervals at a steady tempo pace of 2.7 – 3.0 w/kg. This is the safety net for those who want a solid workout without going “into the red.”

The Challenge
Start with the Yellow Beacon. Your goal is to hold that higher intensity for as long as possible. If the effort becomes unsustainable or your heart rate climbs too high, don’t worry—simply ease back to the Red Beacon following behind and finish the interval with that group.

Course & Intensity Notes
Please note that this is a flexible training session:
Terrain Impact: The ride format and group cohesion may change based on the route’s profile. Expect paces to shift slightly on climbs or descents.
Variable Intervals: Interval intensity and duration are subject to change week-to-week based on the specific goals of the session and the total distance of the chosen course.

Pro Tip: Use the draft! Whether you’re with the Yellow or Red group, staying tucked in a pack will help you maintain these tempo zones more efficiently.
Pro Tip: Keep an eye on the on-screen chat. The Beacons will announce interval starts, finishes, and any adjustments to the target w/kg based on the terrain.

Ride Rules
Be Kind: This is a supportive training environment.
Listen to your body: There is no shame in dropping back to the Red Beacon; that’s exactly why it’s there!
Stay Predictable: Avoid sudden surges so the groups can stay formed.

It’s game on. Power Play is four weeks of gameplay-inspired riding designed to help you beat your best. Each stage puts a different Zwift feature in play, with guided cues, curated PowerUps, and rewards along the way.

STAGE 2 — SHORT TEMPO
Route: Sacré Trois!
Distance: 27.6 km / 17.1 mi
Elevation: 228 m / 748 ft
Three trips up the Montmartre KOM. Your first effort sets the benchmark, while your HoloReplay returns on efforts two and three as the rival to beat. Use your Feather PowerUp wisely to shave off seconds and find an edge.

Set up your HoloReplay for your best personal efforts. Go to Settings and then Preferences—set Segment HoloReplay to Most Recent, Leaderboard HoloReplay to Hide, and HoloReplay Privacy to Private.

name: DWGZ's 5th Annual Friendsgiving Turkey Trot with Vegan Options 100KM
description:
5th Annual DWGZ Friendsgiving Turkey Trot (with Vegan Options) — 100 km

Welcome to DWGZ (Determined Witty Gritty Zwifters), a global crew of cyclists who show up with grit, humor, heart, and an appetite. For the fifth year running, the pack is rolling out on Thanksgiving morning to give thanks the DWGZ way: 100 km together, before anyone touches the stuffing.

What a year 2026 has been for DWGZ. New faces, old friends, early alarms, legendary pulls, a few questionable sprints, and a lot of miles shared from every corner of the globe. Some of us met up IRL, some of us just met on a 6:05 AM wheel, and all of us got a little stronger because of each other.

This ride is our thank-you. To the DWGZ ambassadors who've led, swept, and shepherded this pack over the years: thank you. To the noobs who clipped in this year and somehow came back the next day: welcome to the family. You can't leave now. We know where your avatar lives.

Bring a side dish. Bring a joke. Bring both if you're brave. We'll be sharing favorite Thanksgiving sides and our best (and worst) jokes along the way, so come ready to laugh, groan, and type "😂" mid-climb. Vegan options are available, and so are tofurky puns.

Why 100 km? Science says it burns roughly one slice of pie. Maybe a slice and a half if you pull. We didn't check the science.

Ride Categories
🚴 B Category – 3.2–4.0 w/kg
🚴 C Category – 2.8–3.2 w/kg
🚴 D Category – 2.0–2.6 w/kg

Expect a steady, social pace, smooth rotation, and a welcoming group from yellow beacon to sweep. Nobody gets dropped on Thanksgiving. That's the only rule. (Second rule: no carving the turkey on the downhills.)

DWGZ rides run seven days a week at 6:05 AM Eastern (US), each one a chance to build strength, connection, and global community. On Thursday we ride for gratitude.

Keep the tradition rolling. Clip in, gobble up the kilometers, and give thanks with the pack. 🦃🐾

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 43K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

name: AATC Thursday Interval Workout
description:
WORKOUT DESIGNER

Matt Dana of the Ann Arbor Triathlon Club - Group workouts make training so much more fun. The Ann Arbor Triathlon Club promotes the sport of triathlon in Southeast Michigan. We have all levels of Triathletes.  

ABOUT GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedaling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop.

HELPFUL HINT

We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests as the estimated FTP can be inaccurate and make the difficulty level of the workouts too high for your current fitness level. 

For more info on FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift

name: OutSeason with Endurance Nation
description:
Get stronger on the bike this winter in two hours a week.

You’ll head into next season with more strength, endurance, and power than base miles alone can give you, and you’ll build it on two focused one-hour rides a week. Tuesday and Thursday are the quality sessions. When work or life gets in the way, Saturday is your make-up day, so a busy week doesn’t cost you the progress.

This is the first 9 weeks of Endurance Nation’s OutSeason cycling series, and it’s not an experiment. More than 10,000 cyclists and triathletes have used it over the last 20 years to show up in the spring faster than they left in the fall.

Spend this winter on targeted work and see what it does for your next season. Learn more at www.endurancenation.us/outseason.

name: EMU Japan Short Race
description:
(Japanese follows)
Welcome to the EMU Japan Short Race!

・POWER UPs:Allowed at all times
・BIKES: No TT bike
・CATEGORY: Use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg then pick the correct group

A:4.0 W/kg FTP+
B:3.2 W/kg to 4.0 W/kg FTP
C:2.5 W/kg to 3.1 W/kg FTP
D:Under 2.4 W/kg FTP

All racers using zPower will be DQ
Heart rate monitors compulsory for all categories

The following persons may be DQ by the organizer's authority.
・Obviously wrong category
・Riding in an unrealistic manner

Final results will be based on ZwiftPower.
Have Fun! Ride On!!

EMU Japan Short Raceにようこそ！ EMUで人気のあるコースを中心に選択し、コースは毎週変わります！
みなさんの参加をお待ちしています。

・POWER UPs: アイテム使用可能
・BIKES: TTバイクは使用不可

・カテゴリーに関して
あなたのFTPを体重で割った数値をパワーウエイトレシオ【○○W/kg】となります。
例：FTP250W、体重60kgの方は4.166W/kgになりますのでAカテゴリーを選択下さい。
FTPとはサイクリストが1時間を通して維持できるパワーになります。 FTPの数値がわからない方はZwift Workout内のFTPテストで計測出来ます。

A:4.0W/kg FTP以上の方
B:3.2W/kg～4.0W/kg FTPの方
C:2.5W/kg～3.1W/kg FTPの方
D:2.4W/kg FTP以下の方

・リザルト
公正なレースを行うために、最終的なリザルトはZwiftpower.comといたします。

・注意事項
レース中の誹謗中傷コメントや、妨害やその他、スポーツマンシップに反する行為を行った参加者を結果から除外することができます。

・イベントの詳細は、注意事項はEMUのTwitterでも随時お知らせしていますので、ご確認お願いいたします。

name: WTRL Team Time Trial - Zone11
description:
WTRL Team Time Trial #397

Our weekly WTRL Team Time Trial (TTT) allows teams of 3-8 Zwifters to race against the clock together throughout the day to achieve the fastest possible times. Teams are arranged into WTRL's unique Coffee Classes and feature both women's only Coffee Classes and mixed gender too.
  
 There are 30 racing events and teams can be registered up 30 minutes before each race event starts at www.wtrl.racing/ttt-home/ and you can pick your start time from the available slots. Each team is issued a unique RacePass that must be clicked by each team member to gain access to the event for sign-up. You'll also be able to check out the rules, course records and results which update live throughout the day.
  
 Teams & Riders must be registered with www.WTRL.racing and you'll need to be sharing data, via your Zwift Profile Connections with www.zwiftpower.com.
  
 If you are looking for a team, head to our dedicated WTRL TTT Facebook page where plenty of teams are always happy to welcome guest riders and new team mates (https://www.facebook.com/groups/WTRLTTT). Not on Facebook? Feel free to drop us an email with your preferred WTRL TTT Zone and current Zwift Category 
  
 #wtrl #wtrlttt

name: Stage 2 - Zwift Power Play
description:
It’s game on. Power Play is four weeks of gameplay-inspired riding designed to help you beat your best. Each stage puts a different Zwift feature in play, with guided cues, curated PowerUps, and rewards along the way.

STAGE 2 — SHORT TEMPO
Route: Sacré Trois!
Distance: 27.6 km / 17.1 mi
Elevation: 228 m / 748 ft
Three trips up the Montmartre KOM. Your first effort sets the benchmark, while your HoloReplay returns on efforts two and three as the rival to beat. Use your Feather PowerUp wisely to shave off seconds and find an edge.

Set up your HoloReplay for your best personal efforts. Go to Settings and then Preferences—set Segment HoloReplay to Most Recent, Leaderboard HoloReplay to Hide, and HoloReplay Privacy to Private.

name: Zwift Women's Training Club Workout
description:
Welcome to the Zwift Women’s Training Club workouts! 

ZWTC is your community for fun and fitness. Our weekly workouts will take you through some of Zwift’s most popular training plans, and with the flexibility to join in any time, regardless of where we are in the plan! Get the most out of your Zwifting with training designed by world-class coaches, like 3x Olympic Gold medalist, Kristin Armstrong!

The group workouts will be held every 3 hours UTC on Tuesdays and Thursdays. We’ll also offer recovery rides every 3 hours on Wednesdays - be on the look out for special guests joining those! Our main goal is to provide you with a consistent experience week in and week out, to challenge yourself in a supportive group setting, making friends and getting fit along the way! 

Join the Zwift Women’s Training Club to connect with new ride friends, ask questions, and get advice from experts.  https://www.zwift.com/clubs/ZwiftWTC/join

Love these workouts? Check out the club for more opportunities to train with us! We offer social rides every 3 hours on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays in addition to the Tuesday/Thursday workouts.

name: Train with Dan and Lorraine
description:
Norwegian 4 x 4's

Warm up ramp at the start, then easy, then a short effort to finish the warm up, another short easy section, and then it's in to 4 lots of 4 minutes at Vo2 Max, with 4 minutes very easy recovery between each. It's a hard session, but it's meant to be hard.

name: EMU Japan Race
description:
(Japanese follows) 
Welcome to the EMU Japan Race! POWER UPs:Allowed at all times BIKES:All allowed CATEGORY: Use your FTP and then divide by your weight in kg then pick the correct group: A:4.0 W/kg FTP+ B:3.2 W/kg to 4.0 W/kg FTP C:2.5 W/kg to 3.1 W/kg FTP D:Under 2.4 W/kg FTP ROUTE: CHAMPS-ELYSEES 6.60km(1lap) Have Fun! Ride On!!

EMU Japan Race 毎週火/木曜日に開催するEMU公式レース!!
EMUで人気のあるコースを中心に選択。
コースは毎週変わります！
Zwifterの参加をお待ちしています。
POWER UPs:アイテム使用可能 BIKES:全ての自転車を選択可能 カテゴリーに関して あなたのFTPを体重で割った数値をパワーウエイトレシオ【○○W/kg】となります。
例：FTP250W、体重60kgの方は4.166W/kgになりますのでAカテゴリーを選択下さい。
FTPとはサイクリストが1時間を通して維持できるパワーになります。 FTPの数値がわからない方はZwift Workout内のFTPテストで計測出来ます。
A:4.0W/kg FTP以上の方
B:3.2W/kg～4.0W/kg FTPの方
C:2.5W/kg～3.1W/kg FTPの方
D:2.4W/kg FTP以下の方
Have Fun! Ride On!! #EMU Speed Club #ZwiftJapan
